description: Unit test class for the ImmutableFeature class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package. Contains tests for creation, immutability, property manipulation, JSON serialization, equality, and builder pattern functionality.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior of ImmutableFeature instances including creation, equality, immutability, property management, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods of ImmutableFeature are correctly implemented using the EqualsVerifier library.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableFeature and related classes are immutable, considering known immutable types and caching behavior.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Ensures that creating an ImmutableFeature with a null id throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullProperties
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableFeature with null properties and verifies it results in an empty JSON string.

methods.name: createInstanceWithLeadingSlash
methods.description: Tests that providing a feature ID with a leading slash throws a JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithEndingSlash
methods.description: Tests that providing a feature ID with an ending slash throws a JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithInbetweenSlash
methods.description: Tests that providing a feature ID with slashes in between throws a JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: getIdReturnsExpected
methods.description: Asserts that getId() returns the expected feature ID.

methods.name: getPropertiesOnFeatureWithoutPropertiesReturnsEmptyOptional
methods.description: Verifies that getProperties() on a feature without properties returns an empty Optional.

methods.name: getPropertiesReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getProperties() returns the correct properties set.

methods.name: setPropertiesWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests that setProperties() returns a new feature instance with updated properties.

methods.name: removePropertiesWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that removeProperties() returns a feature with empty properties.

methods.name: getPropertyFromFeatureWithoutProperties
methods.description: Checks that requesting a property from a feature without properties returns an empty Optional.

methods.name: tryToGetNonExistingProperty
methods.description: Ensures that retrieving a non-existent property yields an empty Optional.

methods.name: getExistingProperty
methods.description: Verifies that an existing property can be retrieved correctly.

methods.name: tryToSetPropertyValueWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Ensures that setting a property with a null pointer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToSetPropertyWithNullValue
methods.description: Verifies that setting a null value throws a NullPointerException with correct message.

methods.name: setPropertyValueOnFeatureWithoutProperties
methods.description: Tests setting a property on a feature that initially has no properties, expecting a new feature with the property set.

methods.name: setPropertyValueOnFeatureWithExistingProperties
methods.description: Tests updating a property in a feature that already has properties.

methods.name: tryToRemoveNonExistingProperty
methods.description: Ensures removing a non-existent property returns the same feature instance.

methods.name: tryToRemovePropertyFromFeatureWithEmptyProperties
methods.description: Checks that removing a property from a feature with empty properties returns the same instance.

methods.name: removeExistingProperty
methods.description: Verifies that removing an existing property results in a feature without that property.

methods.name: jsonSerializationWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Ensures that toJson() produces the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: toStringContainsExpectedKeywords
methods.description: Checks that toString() output contains expected identifiers.

methods.name: ensureFeatureNewBuilderWorks
methods.description: Tests the builder pattern for ImmutableFeature creates a feature identical to a known reference.

methods.name: ensureFeatureToBuilderWorks
methods.description: Checks that toBuilder() creates an identical feature instance.

methods.name: getDefinitionFromFeatureWithoutDefinitionReturnsEmptyOptional
methods.description: Verifies getDefinition() returns empty Optional when no definition is set.

methods.name: getDefinitionReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getDefinition() retrieves the expected definition.

methods.name: setDefinitionWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies setting a new definition placeholder.

methods.name: removeDefinitionFromFeatureWithoutDefinitionReturnsSameFeature
methods.description: Ensures removing a definition from a feature without one returns the same feature.

methods.name: removeDefinitionWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Checks that removeDefinition() correctly removes the definition.
